#pour tous je mets le supply shock devant

library(abind)

save_rds_path <- 'Z:/prix_electricite_gitlab/VAR_analysis_fr/VAR_output/plot_irfs_rds/log_diff/irf'
setwd(save_rds_path)
irf_cholesky_esp <- readRDS("irf_cholesky_esp_spot_first_log_diff.rds")
# Convert to 20 x 5 x 5
irf_cholesky_esp <- abind(irf_cholesky_esp, along = 3)

#normalize cholesky
#irf_cholesky_esp <- irf_cholesky_esp[1:20, c(2,1,3,4), c(2,1,3,4)]
# Normalize so that the first time step = 1 for each (variable, shock) pair
irf_cholesky_esp_norm <- irf_cholesky_esp

for (var in 1:dim(irf_cholesky_esp)[2]) {
  for (shock in 1:dim(irf_cholesky_esp)[3]) {
    first_val <- irf_cholesky_esp[1, var,  var]
    irf_cholesky_esp_norm[, var, shock] <- irf_cholesky_esp[, var, shock] / first_val
  }
}

```{r}
irf_list <- list_irfs
compare_irf <- function(irf_list, variable_names, shock = "price") {
  n_irf <- length(irf_list)
  names(irf_list)
  if (shock == "price"){
   shock_label = "$P_{elec}$ shock IRF"
  }else if (shock == "gen"){
    shock_label = "$Q_{elec}$ shock IRF"
  }else{
    return("Invalid shock type. Please use 'price' or 'quantity'.")
  }

  #solution <-gen_benchmark
  plot_irf <- function(i=1) {
    #i=3
    #trick I just put 0.5 twice
    #main_IV <- lambda_0[, i, "lower"]
    # Combine all IRFs into one data frame
    #irf_list[[4]][1:20, i, 1]
    df_all <- lapply(seq_along(irf_list), function(j) {
      data.frame(
        time = time_horizon,
        value = irf_list[[j]][1:20, i, 1],
        model = names(irf_list)[j]
      )
    }) %>% bind_rows()
    
    ggplot(df_all, aes(x = time, y = value, color = model)) +
      geom_line(linetype = "solid") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
      labs(
        title = TeX(variable_names[i]),
        x = "Time",
        y = "Unit Points"
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Cholesky" ="blue" ,   "IV MR"="red" ,      "IV SD" = "green" ,     "Joint IV SD"= "darkgreen"),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
      guides(color = "none")+
      theme_minimal()
  
  }

  # Generate plots
  plots_list <- lapply(1:n, plot_irf)
  grid_plots <- do.call("grid.arrange", c(plots_list, nrow = 2))
  
  legend_plot <- plot_grid(grid_plots, custom_legend , ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.1))
  return(legend_plot)
  
}
plot_irf(i=1)
```
